flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob, helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper}, framework/schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, resources/{cron-schedules-prod.properties, application-{dev,uat,prod}.properties}. Other repos: not used. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ is not used as evidence.
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark: Vault Code Split (Vault must run because the notice needs vehicle and owner info, Vault permission is granted to the App Service). There is no flow deck. The contact checks before the electronic reminder are done by NotificationSmsEmailJob (reminder query for stages RD1-DR3, exclusion list, passport, DataHive refresh, contact validation) and the logic is the same as in the OCMS11.x/OCMS12.x stories for other stages; for last stage RD2 the notice is included with templates RD2_*. Gaps: (1) the contact refresh from DataHive/DOS is off (cron.enareminder.datahive=false in dev/UAT/prod), so the stored contact is used; (2) the whole eNotification job is switched off (cron.notification.enabled=false in dev/UAT/prod) so per the properties the checks do not run by themselves in any environment, plus sms.enable=false and email.enableSmtp=false in prod; (3) the template text is in the DB and cannot be confirmed to refer to the 2nd letter. Vault, DOS and the App Service permission cannot be verified from repo. Tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed, deployed to PRD; remark: waiting for the eNotification cron to be activated).
recommendation: Claim partially. The check logic exists and matches the sibling stories, but the DOS refresh is off and the eNotification job is off in every environment per the repo. Ask for proof that the eNotification cron is active in PRD and for the RD2 template in the DB.

steps.step: After the 2nd letter is processed, OCMS selects owner notices inside the electronic reminder window (last stage RD2, approaching due date)
steps.detail: queryRecordsForReminder selects notices with last_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3) (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1114), so a notice whose 2nd letter was just processed (last stage RD2) is included. The due date is last_processing_date + POS + PDD per stage and must be <= today + ENOTEDAYS (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1103-1109 dan 1115-1118); only notices without suspension (or TS-HST), vehicle type not I/D/V, and with no SMS/email send record for the same stage inside the retry window (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1119-1130 dan 1135-1151). The job marks the result with stage RD2 (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:174-182). Note: the stage can advance to RD2 even when the letter file never reaches the vendor (see OCMS12.7). The eNotification job is off in every environment per properties (see the last step).

steps.step: Owners who opted out of electronic reminders (exclusion list) or passport holders are not sent anything
steps.detail: The reminder query drops IDs found in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1131-1134) and the job checks again with the preloaded list: an ID in the exclusion list is skipped (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-232); passport holders cannot be eNotified at any stage and are skipped (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:234-243). The reminder stage is not moved back; the notice is already on the letter track. The content of the exclusion list is DB data: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS gets the latest mobile number (individual) or email (company) of the owner from DOS (DataHive)
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo then refreshContactInfo per record (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188). Individuals are checked against DataHive Singpass (refreshIndividualContactInfo, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2770) and companies against DataHive CorpPass by UEN (refreshCompanyContactInfo, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2496-2598). But the whole refresh only runs when cron.enareminder.datahive = 'true' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:92-93, 2325-2340, 2461-2485) and the value is false in dev, UAT and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48), so the contact used is the one already stored in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver. DataHive = DOS of the story, the DataHive view content and the Vault permission: cannot verify from repo. Same as OCMS11.10 (company) and as the contact source step in OCMS12.9 and OCMS12.10.

steps.step: Owners without a valid mobile number (individual) or email (company) are skipped
steps.detail: validateContactInfo: a record with contactError is rejected; a company (id_type B) must have an email, an individual must have a phoneNo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2290). A failing record is skipped with a log and does not enter the batch (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:254-266); the move to stage RD1 is only for ENA notices, stage RD2 is left unchanged. Completeness of the contact data in the DB cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: Owners with a valid contact are passed to the electronic reminder batch that refers to the 2nd letter
steps.detail: Records that pass the steps above enter the SMS batch (individuals, NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:280-292) or the email send (companies, NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:353-354), with a template named <stage>_<channel>_<recipient>, so for last stage RD2 RD2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL or RD2_EMAIL_COMPANY is used (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:459-476). The actual sending is the scope of OCMS12.9 and OCMS12.10. The scheduler skips execution when cron.notification.enabled=false (NotificationJobsScheduler.java:30-31, 48-52) and the value is false in dev, UAT and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236, comment: 'Disabled in PROD to prevent sending SMS/Email notifications'). In prod sms.enable=false also applies with no sms.allowedSources, so SmsUtil.sendBatchSms refuses source ENOTIFICATION (application-prod.properties:87; SmsUtil.java:401-410). In UAT ENOTIFICATION is in sms.allowedSources (application-uat.properties:82) but the cron stays off. Real activation of the eNotification cron in PRD: OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed) carries the remark 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate before close this ticket'. Since the job is off per repo, the checks above do not actually run in prod. The template text (whether it refers to the 2nd letter) is in ocms_template_store (DB): cannot verify from repo.
